design_status: Post-result trend sensitivity, not independent confirmation.
research_question: Does the negative cross-architecture post interaction remain after allowing a linear exposure-specific trajectory?
sample: Exact 12,780-row, 2,556-firm panel from Experiment 09; no row, firm, industry, or variable change.
primary_model: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_industry-year + delta(ArchitectureCount_i x (year-2021)) + beta(ArchitectureCount_i x Post2022_t) + error_it
primary_parameter: beta, an RCEP-period level break beyond the exposure-specific linear trend.
inference: Firm-clustered standard errors and 999 architecture-count permutations within the frozen industry-by-size-tercile strata, seed 20260723.

robustness_gate.survives: beta remains negative and stratified-randomization p < 0.05.
robustness_gate.fails: beta changes sign or stratified-randomization p >= 0.05; Experiment 09 cannot be described as robust to trend continuation.
robustness_gate.interpretation: Even survival does not solve the two-pre-period limitation; failure materially weakens the causal route.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended before execution.
